## Download

| Computer | File |
|---|---|
| Windows (64-bit, Intel/AMD or ARM) | [**Locker-Manager-Setup-{{VERSION}}.exe**](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/Locker-Manager-Setup-{{VERSION}}.exe) |
| Mac (Apple silicon or Intel) | [**Locker-Manager-{{VERSION}}-universal.dmg**](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/Locker-Manager-{{VERSION}}-universal.dmg) |

If you already have Locker Manager installed, you do not need to download anything: it updates itself.

### First time opening it

Locker Manager is free and open source, and is not yet registered with Apple or Microsoft, so the first time you open it your computer shows a one-off "unrecognised app" warning. The app is safe and runs entirely on your own computer. Here is exactly what to click.

**On Windows**

1. Run the downloaded `Locker-Manager-Setup` file. If your browser asks, choose **Keep**.
2. If a blue "Windows protected your PC" screen appears, click the small **More info** link.
3. Click **Run anyway**, then follow the installer.

**On a Mac**

1. Open the downloaded `.dmg` and drag **Locker Manager** into **Applications**.
2. Open **Locker Manager** from Applications once. macOS will say it cannot check it and offer only **Done**. Click Done.
3. Open **System Settings**, then **Privacy & Security**, scroll to the bottom and click **Open Anyway**, then **Open Anyway** again.
4. You only do this once. After that, open it like any other app.

Updates install themselves on Windows and on a Mac. On a Mac this needs the app to be in your Applications folder and your account to be allowed to change it; otherwise the app tells you when a new version is out and opens this download page, and you install the new version over the old one. Copies older than 0.11.0 on a Mac cannot update themselves yet: install 0.11.0 or later from this page once, and from then on it updates itself.
